fullContent:
Panchasama Churna 
 Reference – Sharangadhara Samhita madhyama khanda 6/ 93-94. 
 Introduction 
 Panchasama Churna is an herbal formulation that is prepared from mixture of five herbs. This is known to treat the problems of digestive system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Sauvarcala Lavana – Sochal salt 
 Pippali – Long pepper 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Trivrit – Operculina turpethum 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the herbs up to 10 grams and powder separately. Mix all the ingredients. 
 Dose 
 One to four grams, three times a day, before or after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Piles 
 Loss of appetite 
 Bloating 
 Abdominal pain 
 
 Contraindications 
 Over dose can cause gastric irritation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
